temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days. When Carolyn asks if she is alright, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and some personal stuff, and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging and sociable; there is no known reason for concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn's quietness and her response suggest she is overwhelmed by work and personal issues.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is unusually quiet because she is overwhelmed by work and personal matters, not because of anything Carolyn has done.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer support and let Marilyn know Carolyn is available to talk if needed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn had been curt in a subsequent interaction. When Carolyn apologizes and shares her own tough times, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is overwhelmed, but her curtness may mean Carolyn overstepped or Marilyn is upset with her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn's apology and explanation clarify that her curtness was not personal and that she is having a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is not upset with Carolyn; she appreciates Carolyn's support and is struggling personally or at work.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Confused and hurt, then relieved and empathetic
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear up the misunderstanding, stay supportive, and be patient with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's openness. When invited to a small gathering, Marilyn says it sounds lovely and that she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn appreciates Carolyn's support, and their relationship is improving after their previous conversation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn's acceptance and enthusiasm indicate she is open to a closer friendship outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn values the connection and wants to attend Carolyn's gathering; their friendship is strengthening.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To strengthen the friendship and host the gathering as a chance to bond.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Marilyn still seems to maintain professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Their friendship is growing outside work, but Marilyn still seems distant at work, which disappoints and confuses Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn's response suggests the distance may not be intentional and that she is willing to improve their work dynamic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The work distance is not necessarily personal or intentional, and they can improve collaboration by talking.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused, then cautiously reassured
temporal_state_chain.intention: To address their work dynamic directly and work on improving collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn feels they cleared the air and understand boundaries. Marilyn agrees enthusiastically to team up on the new project, says she is glad they talked, and looks forward to working closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: They have cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; collaboration should improve.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn's agreement confirms that the improved understanding and partnership are mutual.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: They have a stronger, more mutually understood working relationship, and Marilyn is eager to collaborate.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and continue working closely.
